svg.aria-label: A ten by ten self-attention weight matrix for the character slice the lamp k, shown as a blue heatmap where each row is a probability distribution summing to one.
svg.text: Attention matrix A for “the lamp k” (T = 10)
Cell A[i, j] = how much query position i (row) draws from key position j (column). Each row sums to 1.
- - - diagonal = self-attention (position i attending to itself).
Rows/cols 3 and 8 are identical: both are the space char (no positional info yet).
Not symmetric: A[0,7] = .64 but A[7,0] = 0 — ‘t’ attends to ‘p’, not the reverse.
